mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing lungs to circulation brought the chapter together: the result traces oxygen from air to blood and onward to tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two assembly-order surprises were somewhat repetitive. In both cases, I had the right components in mind but tried to attach one before assembling its partner.

surprise.text: I expected the thin lining to fit directly into the air route; learning that it first had to join the capillary mesh made the two sides of the exchange surface clearer.

arbitrary.text: The required order for joining the pleural membranes felt a little arbitrary at first, although the resulting picture clarified their connections to the chest and lungs.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the chapter connected physical construction to explanations of surface area, pressure and transport, and I am curious how another body system would fit into that route.
